dossier.identity: web-spinning breaker who pins, slows and reveals a pack under silk it weaves faster than they can cut it~
dossier.selectionRationale: breaker because the filament rifle breaks formations rather than bursting targets: slows, roots and reveals set up the team's burst, and the arachnoid lower chassis doubles as a deployable dome anchor. distinct from nixie's resin snares and mira's single gravity cage by shaping a whole lane with overlapping strips. hypothesis kit (owner decision 2026-11-07).
dossier.weaponConcept: filament rifle (high-tension polymer filament rifle with filament spool, tension chamber, smart nozzle for pattern control, synthetic-gel coolant unit and a modular rail that docks the arachnoid lower chassis)

lore.backstory: a lane-weaver for a rooftop logistics guild who learned that a mesh of tactical silk keeps crowds safer than any cordon. when the guild sold its routes she kept the rifle and the eight-legged frame, and now strings the contested blocks into webs that only her friends can walk through~
lore.syndicateRecord: wanted for unlicensed web-mesh barricades across seven transit hubs and for refusing to cut them down when asked nicely.
lore.psychProfile: patient, warm and relentlessly social; treats every fight as a knitting circle where the knots happen to hold people in place.
lore.combatQuote: “i weave connections in a brighter tomorrow, darling. hold still, you are part of the pattern now.”

iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Arachne. Theme: web dome. Subject: a bold eight-legged spider enclosing a single chunky hemispherical web dome. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
